LanguageData.RKU_BioLabRaid_Offer.dialogueText: Comrades, we have grave news. Intelligence from Kingdom records reveals a terrible secret! They have reactivated a secret bioweapon lab! Over a decade ago, under the noble Azalea, viruses from this lab nearly destroyed our striving revolution. We only survived because an agent killed that wicked aristocrat... Now we intercept Kingdom resources moving to this facility. We don't know their exact work, but if they succeed, it threatens us all. We must destroy this facility. We need your help. Eliminate all resistance. Dismantle their research. Free the enslaved. Secure the dangerous creations. This mission will be hard but vital. Move out when preparations are complete! Our forces are ready! The Second Battalion will provide artillery support!
LanguageData.RKU_EmergencyCallFir.dialogueText: Hold your ground! Underground Radio Communication Network is responding to your distress signal. Reinforcements are on the way!
LanguageData.RKU_FirstContact.dialogueText: Thank you for rescuing our scouts, surface friends. We are the Partisans, an underground movement fighting aristocrats and warlords to free the poor. This encrypted channel is now yours. We can trade vital supplies or work together on larger missions, if we share the same goals as comrades. (Faction relationship restricted to -25 to 25)
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_AncientRaid.dialogueT: Comrades, our scouts found an ancient base held by enemies! It is an old military structure with powerful tech and weapons inside. Warlords are there, digging up the old tech. If we take it, we secure this precious legacy and stop them from using it. The enemy is heavily armed. We will send elite troops with prototype weapons to back you up!
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_FactoryDefense.dialog: (Noisy signal tones)Comrades, we have an emergency! Our underground drill factory is under heavy attack by Royal Army! It is our only production site. If we lose it, our Partisan movement will collapse. The enemy broke through our outer defenses and is moving toward the center. We need you to hurry there and help our troops defend it. Save the machines and workers! These attackers are very strong, likely backed by the Kingdom or others. We depend on your quick help to survive. But if we stop them, we could end this war for good!
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_FarmRaid.dialogueText: Comrades, we found an important target! A warlord-run farm is nearby. They force civilians to grow food for them. It is a key supply base for their forces. The farm has strong defenses with watchtowers and patrols. If we take it, we cut the warlords' food supply. We also get food for the local people. Help us free these people from their oppression!
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_RoyalNegotiation.dial: The Kingdom's Gardeners extend our most cordial greetings to you and your people, dear friend. We dispatch this communication to apprise you that a band of insurgents, proscribed by the Kingdom, have infiltrated your domain. Where these vermin traverse, fertile fields fall barren, herds scatter without trace, and waters yield no sustenance. They subsist upon hatred itself, propagating desolation in their wake. As the scions of the Flourishing Blossom, we cannot remain passive whilst such tragedy threatens to revisit itself upon your lands.
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_RoyalNegotiationB.dia: Dear Friend of the Flourishing Blossom: The grand victory you recently achieved has resounded throughout the Kingdom. Countless scions of the Flourishing Blossom, who have endured persecution at the hands of those villains, and the Ratkin subjects displaced by the turmoil, have shed tears of joy at this heartening news. The Flourishing Blossom are most eager to make the acquaintance and friendship of such a natural commander and lord as yourself. Those improper allegations regarding your land claims, once raised in the Kingdom's councils, are gradually being dispelled through the efforts of the Gardeners inspired by your example. To return to the matter at hand, the successes you have secured for the Kingdom have caused those unscrupulous villains considerable distress, leading them to devise a mad scheme of retaliation against the Kingdom. Our intelligence indicates that these shameless villains have targeted locations within the Kingdom where defences are sparse, such as refugee shelters and orphanages, places where large numbers of unarmed civilians gather. They have deployed numerous armed sappers carrying explosives, and we assess their intent is likely to perpetrate large-scale acts of terror... Our garrison outposts were unable to provide immediate reinforcement. In this exigency, a number of the Gardeners, those scions of the Flourishing Blossom who are profoundly concerned for the fate of those civilians and act out of compassion, took it upon themselves to employ certain signal deception techniques to redirect the assault towards your impregnable walls. Now that the matter is settled, we have disciplined those Gardeners who acted without authorisation, and we hope you will not harbour any resentment on this account. We are also confident that, given your talents, these villains' clumsy plots pose no serious threat. Following this incident, the Kingdom will provide you with appropriate compensation, and once again extend recognition and rewards for your noble actions.
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_RoyalNegotiationC.dia: To the Kingdom's steadfast ally, our intelligence indicates... that the commander of those rebels, the notorious "Cheese" Zigstark, shall personally lead the greater part of the underground insurgents in an assault upon your location. The final eyewitness report from our informant suggests these rebels are prepared for a protracted siege, possessing ample reserves and artillery support. Furthermore, the elite guard accompanying that chieftain appears to include combat Mechanoids mounted with autocannons, alongside a large apparatus of undetermined purpose... Pray forgive my momentary discomposure. By now, you have doubtless heard certain... unfounded... rumours from captured rebels regarding previous incidents. Very well, I presume you have had your fill of hollow dissembling and flattery. Even without being utilised by the Kingdom, were you not, from the very beginning, quite content to become the bane of those so-called idealists? The Kingdom, however flawed its present state, has endured for a reason. We both serve forces that transcend mere mortal concerns, do we not? Thus I perceive we are ultimately of similar disposition. Listen then. For the Kingdom, and for the "you" behind this transmission, end these rebels' ill-conceived fantasy beneath your walls. The Kingdom's forces are engaged along the border confronting those accursed warlords, thus no official reinforcements shall be forthcoming. It may sound dire, yet I harbour no doubts for a military prodigy of your calibre. Eliminate those insurgents and that wretched Zigstark! The perpetual blooming of the Flourishing Blossom relies not solely upon morning's light and dew, but equally upon the filth and blood of the night. May we both bask in tomorrow's sunlight.
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_WarLord1.dialogueText: Friends, we've identified a key target! A warlord force has been camped here for a long time. They have heavy artillery and deployed a fortified Defense Tower outpost they use to harass our personnel. This stops us from building surface bases. Their position threatens us both. If you eliminate these bandits, we can free up our limited manpower to protect civilians and build surface production facilities."
LanguageData.RKU_ProvideSupport_WarLord2.dialogueText: Thank you for your help. Our Partisan work is going well. The local Ratkin support us. We will remove all warlord influence from this area. The warlord chief is in a nearby fortress. Capturing it would inspire our people. But we cannot send farmers and miners to fight knights. We need your help again for this mission.
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Better.dialogueText: Good. Now we can work together more closely. Our drill teams found promising sites with resources across the territory. We don't have enough people to survey them. We are sending you the coordinates. Keep whatever you find. Some teams may need supplies or have items to trade. We will share these locations with you. (Faction relationship restricted to -25 to 75)
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Excellent.dialogueText: Comrade, your actions show true alliance! Your light guides us in the dark depths. Our drills will always serve you! We will face any threat together. We will build a new future of freedom for all oppressed people! This promise is in our blood, until our last breath!
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Good.dialogueText: Comrades, it's great to be in touch with you! The Partisan fighters are eager to fight alongside you! If you encounter any enemies that need dealing with, you can directly call us for support via the radio! Nearby squads will prioritize your requests, and our troops will move with your deployments to arrive at nearby locations, always ready to provide support. Wherever you go, we'll be together—just call us when it's time to fight! (Faction relationship restricted to -25 to 100)
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Improvement.dialogueText: Our partnership has yielded strong results. We should continue our work together. We will share more opportunities with you... Let us study the unique artifacts found underground. We lack the people and labs to turn them into weapons, but your experts will see their value. Our logistics team can share notes during your research. Together we will prepare special "surprises" for the aristocrats and warlords... (Faction relationship restricted to -25 to 50)
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Warning_Critical.dialogueTe: Execrable warlords! Soulless beasts! May you all die in explosions! We will blast your positions to dust. Nothing of your cursed enterprise will remain!
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Warning_Light.dialogueText: You killed our people. We know! Our forces are nearby. Stop provoking us. We may still talk. (Faction relationship remains at -75. Regain goodwill through other means, or click Support key to contact Royal Army for next event)
LanguageData.RKU_Relation_Warning_Serious.dialogueTex: We warned you. Still you destroyed our villages! They were civilians. How are you different from the warlords? We will fight back. This blood debt will be paid!\n(Note: Faction relationship is now fixed at -75. Killing Partisan members while hostile won't reduce relationship. Harmful surgeries or other actions still can.)
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchReward_Assault.dialogueText: Thank you for your help! We have organized assault weapon blueprints. We are sending the schematics to your researchers. This will strengthen our combined forces.
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchReward_Experimental.dialogue: We sent the blueprints for our new underground weapons. We just finished initial tests on these new arms. They need more rigorous trials before use. When ready, we will ask your workshops to build the first prototypes.
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchReward_Experimental2.dialogu: Good results on the verification. These weapons will be strong in combat. You must find the materials underground. The finished prototypes will make our enemies pay! We trust your field testing. Use them well!
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchReward_Guerrilla.dialogueTex: We will share our equipment making methods. These are simple tools, but they have proven reliable in many battles.
